title: Command & Conquer 3: Tiberium Wars
provenance: Reported by Bokka1980 (upstream#305, 2026-10-04), Apple M2, macOS 27.0.1, KLYC-Box 0.9.39, engine x64-crossover26.3-r12 (the Wine 11 engine), DXMT as the environment's mode, no recipes listed, rated 5 of 5 after 25 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: A 2007 Direct3D 9 real-time strategy game. Reported perfect after 25 minutes on an M2 with the environment on DXMT on the Wine 11 engine r12. DXMT itself handles Direct3D 10 and 11 only, and on the Wine 11 engine KLYC-Box's automatic modes leave Direct3D 9 to Wine's own Direct3D (the rule the Fallout: New Vegas report confirmed in its log), so that is most likely what drew the game, an inference from the app's rule rather than from this reporter's log. On the default Wine 10 engine the same mode attaches DXVK's Direct3D 9 instead, and whether the game runs there was not reported. No frame rate was given and nothing was measured here.
